text: Eochaid Ollathair means father of all. The name belongs to the great god the Dagda. Koch explains that his name reads as good god. This title invites a bond with the Norse Óðin, the all-father. In the Mythological Cycle the Dagda ruled the Tuath Dé. He appears at full length in the Second Battle of Mag Tuired. He was the father of Oengus Mac ind Óc and of Brigit. He mated with Bóand and with the Morrígan. He has been read as a god of sky, storm, earth, and sun.
